title: Bitwise ORs of Subarrays
description: Given an integer array `arr` of non-negative integers, consider the bitwise OR of every non-empty contiguous subarray `arr[i..j]` (`0 <= i <= j < arr.length`). Return the number of distinct bitwise OR results across all subarrays.
hints: Maintain the set `cur` of all distinct bitwise ORs of subarrays ending at the current index `j`.
As a subarray extends leftward, its bitwise OR can only turn `0` bits into `1` bits, so `cur` holds at most 32 distinct values at any step.

examples.explanation: The only non-empty subarray is [0], giving 1 distinct value: {0}.
The distinct subarray ORs are {1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7}, totaling 6.
